title: A Scalable Vector Graphics Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.21893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics are a fundamental medium for resolution-independent visual content, yet the deep learning community lacks a continuous, dense, and invertible latent space for vector representations, the kind of foundational building block that Variational Autoencoders and their descendants have long provided for raster images. We introduce SLS (SVG Latent Space), a Transformer-based autoencoder that learns compact dense representations of individual SVG paths, the atomic visual elements from which any SVG image can be composed. By modeling SVG commands, coordinate data, and visual properties within a unified BPE-based token vocabulary, SLS learns fixed-size latent representations that jointly capture structure and appearance, and can be decoded back into valid, style-consistent SVG paths with high fidelity. translated_title: 可扩展矢量图形的潜在空间
translated_abstract: 可扩展矢量图形是分辨率无关视觉内容的基本媒介，但深度学习社区缺乏一种连续、密集且可逆的矢量表示潜在空间，这种空间是变分自编码器及其后代长期以来为光栅图像提供的基础构建块。我们引入了SLS（SVG潜在空间），一种基于Transformer的自编码器，它学习单个SVG路径的紧凑密集表示，这些路径是组成任何SVG图像的原子视觉元素。通过在统一的基于BPE的令牌词汇表中建模SVG命令、坐标数据和视觉属性，SLS学习固定大小的潜在表示，这些表示共同捕获结构和外观，并能以高保真度解码回有效、风格一致的SVG路径。由此产生的嵌入空间是鲁棒、可逆且结构化的：嵌入位于单位超球面上，从而实现了高效的...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的SVG潜在空间自编码器，首次为矢量图形提供了连续、密集且可逆的潜在表示，能高保真地重建风格一致的SVG路径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Transformer-based SVG latent space autoencoder, providing the first continuous, dense, and invertible latent representation for vector graphics, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction of style-consistent SVG paths.
